name: Entity Add Another
description: Adds a 'Save and add another' button to entity add forms.
project_description:
This module adds a "Save and Add Another" button to any entity type when creating a new entity of that type. This module is an alternative to Entity Save And Add Another module, which has limited entity type support.

 Features 
 This module has a permission to administer the settings and another permission to use the "Save and Add Another" button.

 Post-Installation 
 After installing, navigate to /admin/config/content/entity_add_another to manage which entity types and bundles should include a "Save and Add Another" button on entity creation forms.
